result.topic_en: Reduction of a separated (elliptic/parabolic-coordinate type) PDE to the confluent equation $x u'' + \tfrac12 u' - (x-\alpha)u=0$, its solution by a Laplace-type contour integral, series expansions in terms of Gamma functions, and a sketch of saddle points and integration paths around $\pm1$ for $\alpha/x>1$ and $\alpha/x<1$.

methods.what: Change of variables reducing the separated equation to a confluent (Whittaker-type) ODE
Solving the first-order ODE for the Laplace kernel
Approximation of the exponential by $(1-\frac{x}{n}s)^n$ relating to a hypergeometric function in Riemann P-notation, with quadratic transformation
Series expansions in Gamma (Pi) functions converted into integrals
Contour integral representation of the solution
Saddle-point determination for asymptotic evaluation (steepest descent), with path sketches for the two cases
